def load():

    return G

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=set()
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]!=0 and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    sizes=[-len(c) for c in comps]
    order=[list(comps).index(c) for c in sorted(comps,key=lambda c:-len(c))]
    blocked_rows=set(); blocked_cols=set()
    for k in order:
        c=comps[k]; cy=(min([y for y,_ in c])+max([y for y,_ in c]))//2
        cx=(min([x for _,x in c])+max([x for _,x in c]))//2
        core=g[cy][cx]
        for x in range(W):
            if x in blocked_cols: continue
            out[cy][x]=core
        for y in range(H):
            if y in blocked_rows: continue
            out[y][cx]=core
        # mark rows/cols this component occupies so outer (smaller) components don't paint there? 
        # instead compute blockages from larger comps first
    # redo blocking from largest comps first
    sizeorder=[(len(comps[k]),k) for k in order]
    sizeorder.sort(reverse=True)
    occl=set()  # cells belonging to a "blocking" structure
    for _,k in sizeorder:
        c=comps[k]; cy=(min([y for y,_ in c])+max([y for y,_ in c]))//2
        cx=(min([x for _,x in c])+max([x for _,x in c]))//2
        core=g[cy][cx]
        for x in range(W):
            if x not in blocked_cols: out[cy][x]=core
        for y in range(H):
            if y not in blocked_rows: out[y][cx]=core
        blocked_rows|=set(y for y,_ in c); blocked_cols|=set(x for _,x in c)
    return out

    # components with size>=2 (actual diamonds); centers and colors

def solve(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g)
    shapes=[]
    for cc in cs:
        if len(cc)<2: continue
        ys=[y for y,_ in cc]; xsx=[x for _,x in cc]
        cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))//2; cx=(min(xsx)+max(xsx))//2
        shapes.append((cy,cx,g[cy][cx],cc))
    singles={y for y,_ in [ (p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c]}|set()
    stray_rows=set(y for y,_ in [(p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c])
    stray_cols=set(x for _,x in [(p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cy,cx,col,cc in sorted(shapes,key=lambda s:-len(s)):
        blocked_row=set(); blocked_col=set()
        for y,x in cc:
            pass
        # ray cells: row cy blocked if any stray in that row; col cx similarly
        rb={(y,) for y in range(Hh) if y in stray_rows}
        cb={(x,) for x in range(Ww) if x in stray_cols}
        for x in range(Ww):
            if x in cb or out[cy][x]!=0: continue
            out[cy][x]=col
        for y in range(Hh):
            if y in rb or out[y][cx]!=0: continue
            out[y][cx]=col
    return out

def solve(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g)
    shapes=[]
    for cc in cs:
        if len(cc)<2: continue
        ys=[y for y,_ in cc]; xsx=[x for _,x in cc]
        cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))//2; cx=(min(xsx)+max(xsx))//2
        shapes.append((cy,cx,g[cy][cx],cc))
    S=[(p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c]
    # walls: contiguous runs of >=2 strays in a column (block horizontal rays) or row (block vertical rays)
    wall_c={x for x in range(Ww) if len({r for r,_ in S if _==x})>=2 and all(abs(a-b)==1 for a,b in zip(sorted({r for r,_ in S if _==x}), [b for _,b in sorted([(r,_) for r,_ in S if _==x]),)}) if False else {x for x in range(Ww) if len({r for r,_ in S if _==x})>=2}
    # simpler: column x is a wall if strays at rows r and r+1 both in column x
    wall_c=set(); wall_r=set()
    Sset=set(S)
    for x in range(Ww):
        rs=sorted(r for r,_ in S if _==x)
        if len(rs)>=2 and rs[1]-rs[0]==1: wall_c.add(x)
    for y in range(Hh):
        xs=sorted(x for _,x in S if _==y)
        if len(xs)>=2 and xs[1]-xs[0]==1: wall_r.add(y)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cy,cx,col,cc in sorted(shapes,key=lambda s:-len(s)):
        for x in range(Ww):
            if x in wall_c or out[cy][x]!=0: continue
            out[cy][x]=col
        for y in range(Hh):
            if y in wall_r or out[y][cx]!=0: continue
            out[y][cx]=col
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    shapes=[]
    for c in cs:
        if len(c)<2: continue
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
        cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))//2; cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))//2
        shapes.append((cy,cx,g[cy][cx],c))
    S={(p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c}
    br={y for y,_ in S}; bc={x for _,x in S}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cy,cx,col,c in sorted(shapes,key=lambda s:-len(s)):
        for x in range(W):
            if (cy,x) in c or out[cy][x]!=0 or x in bc: continue
            out[cy][x]=col
        for y in range(H):
            if (y,cx) in c or out[y][cx]!=0 or y in br: continue
            out[y][cx]=col
    return out
print('demo:',solve(G['Demo pair 4 input'])==G['Demo pair 4 output'])

from collections import deque
G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)                     # same-color components
    shapes=[]
    for c in cs:
        if len(c)<2: continue
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
        cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))//2; cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))//2
        shapes.append((cy,cx,g[cy][cx],c))
    S={(p,q) for c in cs if len(c)==1 for p,q in c}
    br={y for y,_ in S}; bc={x for _,x in S}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cy,cx,col,cc in sorted(shapes,key=lambda s:-len(s)):
        for x in range(W):
            if (cy,x) in cc or out[cy][x]!=0 or x in bc: continue
            out[cy][x]=col
        for y in range(H):
            if (y,cx) in cc or out[y][cx]!=0 or y in br: continue
            out[y][cx]=col
    return out
di,do_=G['Demo pair 4 input'],G['Demo pair 4 output']
print('demo:',solve(di)==do_)
o=solve(di)
print([(i,j,o[i][j],do_[i][j]) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]!=do_[i][j]])
ti=G['Test input']; out=solve(ti)
import json; print(json.dumps(out))
